questions.question: Find the values of x, y and z, so as to satisfy the equations given below: x + y + z = 12; x + y – z = 6; x – y + z = 4
questions.questionHtml: Find the values of x, y and z, so as to satisfy the equations given below: x + y + z = 12; x + y – z = 6; x – y + z = 4
questions.solution:
Given: x + y + z = 12 x + y – z = 6 x – y + z = 4

Adding: (x + y + z = 12) + (x + y – z = 6)

2x + 2y = 18, p  > x + y = 9 ...(i)

Subtracting: (x – y + z = 4) from (x + y + z = 12)

2y = 8,y = 4

Substitute y = 4 in (i) → x + 4 = 9, x = 5

Substitute x = 5 and y = 4 in (x + y + z = 12) → 5 + 4 + z = 12,z = 3

questions.question: A policeman noticed a thief at a distance of 500 metres. The policeman started running and the thief also started running at the same time. The thief is running at a speed of 15 km/h. It took 15 minutes for the policeman to catch the thief. Find the speed of the policeman (in km/h).
questions.questionHtml: A policeman noticed a thief at a distance of 500 metres. The policeman started running and the thief also started running at the same time. The thief is running at a speed of 15 km/h. It took 15 minutes for the policeman to catch the thief. Find the speed of the policeman (in km/h).
questions.solution:
First, convert the time taken by the policeman to hours:

Time = 15 minutes = 15 / 60 hours = 0.25 hours

Since the policeman catches the thief, we need to find the relative speed:

Relative Speed = Distance / Time = 500 / 1000 km = 0.5 km

Relative Speed = 0.5 / 0.25 = 2 km/h

Relative Speed = Speed of Policeman - Speed of Thief

2 = x - 15 ⇒ x = 2 + 15 ⇒ x = 17 km/h

questions.question: The given table shows the number of books on different subjects. Subjects Number of books B1 120 B2 150 B3 150 B4 120 B5 120 What is the ratio of the number of books for subject B1 to the average number of books per subject?
questions.questionHtml:
The given table shows the number of books on different subjects.
Subjects Number of books
B1 120
B2 150
B3 150
B4 120
B5 120
What is the ratio of the number of books for subject B1 to the average number of books per subject?
questions.solution:
Total number of books = 120 + 150 + 150 + 120 + 120 = 660

Average number of books = 660 / 5 = 132

Ratio = 120 / 132 = 10 / 11

questions.question: If 2 tan θ = 3, then \(\frac{(3 sin θ - 2 cos θ)}{(3 sin θ + 2 cos θ)}\) is equal to:
questions.questionHtml: If 2 tan θ = 3, then \(\frac{(3 sin θ - 2 cos θ)}{(3 sin θ + 2 cos θ)}\) is equal to:
questions.solution:
2 tan θ = 3, so tan θ = 3/2,

Let opposite = 3k, adjacent = 2k,

Hypotenuse = √(9k² + 4k²) = √(13k²) = √13 k,

sin θ = 3/√13, cos θ = 2/√13 → (3 sin θ - 2 cos θ) / (3 sin θ + 2 cos θ) = (3 × 3/√13 - 2 × 2/√13) / (3 × 3/√13 + 2 × 2/√13) = (9/√13 - 4/√13) / (9/√13 + 4/√13) = 5/13

questions.question: If p cos A = 2q sin A and 2p cosec A - q sec A = 3, then the value of \(p^2 + 4q^2\) is:
questions.questionHtml: If p cos A = 2q sin A and 2p cosec A - q sec A = 3, then the value of \(p^2 + 4q^2\) is:
questions.solution:
Given: p cos A = 2q sin A ⇒ p cos A - 2q sin A = 0 ...eq. (1)
 
2p cosec A - q sec A = 3 ⇒ 2p/sin A - q/cos A = 3 ⇒ 2p cos A - q sin A = 3 sinA cos A ...eq.(2)
 
then eq. (2) - 2 × eq. (1)
 
⇒ 3q sin A = 3 sin A cos A  ⇒ So, q = cos A
 
replacing q = cos A in eq(1):- 2sin A = p
 
So, p2 + 4q2 = (2 sin A)2 + 4(cos A)2 = 4 (sin2 A + cos2 A) = 4

questions.question: Study the given bar-graph and answer the question that follows. The bar-graph shows the sales of books (in thousands) from six branches (B1, B2, B3, B4, B5 and B6) of a publishing company during two consecutive years 2000 and 2001. The total sales of branch B6 for both the years is what percentage of the total sales of branch B3 for both the years (correct up to two decimal places)?
questions.questionHtml:
Study the given bar-graph and answer the question that follows.
The bar-graph shows the sales of books (in thousands) from six branches (B1, B2, B3, B4, B5 and B6) of a publishing
company during two consecutive years 2000 and 2001.

The total sales of branch B6 for both the years is what percentage of the total sales of branch B3 for both the years (correct up to two decimal places)?
questions.solution:
Total sales of B6 = 70,000 + 80,000 = 150,000

Total sales of B3 = 95,000 + 110,000 = 205,000

Percentage = \(\dfrac{150,000}{205,000} \times 100 \)

⇒ Percentage = \(73.17\)%

questions.question: Places A and B are 20 km apart on the highway. A car starts from A and another from B at the same time. If the cars travel in the same direction at different speeds, they meet in one hour. If they travelled towards each other, they met in 12 minutes. What are the speeds (in km/h) of two cars?
questions.questionHtml: Places A and B are 20 km apart on the highway. A car starts from A and another from B at the same time. If the cars travel in the same direction at different speeds, they meet in one hour. If they travelled towards each other, they met in 12 minutes. What are the speeds (in km/h) of two cars?
questions.solution:
Distance = 20 km, Time (same direction) = 1 hr, Time (towards each other) = 12/60 = 1/5 hr, Relative speed (same direction) = |x - y| = 20, Relative speed (towards each other) = x + y = 20 × 5

x + y = 100, |x - y| = 20,

Case: x - y = 20, 2x = 120, x = 60,

60 + y = 100, y = 40,

Speeds are 60 km/h and 40 km/h.

questions.question: If 45º and 65º are the angles of a triangle, then find the exterior angle of the third angle (remaining angle).
questions.questionHtml: If 45º and 65º are the angles of a triangle, then find the exterior angle of the third angle (remaining angle).
questions.solution:
Sum of given angles = 45º + 65º = 110º,


Third angle = 180º - 110º = 70º

Exterior angle of the third angle = 180º - 70º = 110º

questions.question: A right triangle with sides 3 cm, 4 cm and 5 cm is rotated about the sides of 3 cm to form a cone. The volume of the cone so formed is:
questions.questionHtml: A right triangle with sides 3 cm, 4 cm and 5 cm is rotated about the sides of 3 cm to form a cone. The volume of the cone so formed is:
questions.solution:
A right triangle with sides 3 cm, 4 cm, and 5 cm is rotated about the side of 3 cm to form a cone. Volume of the cone, V = (1/3)πr2h

Here, height (h) = 3 cm, radius (r) = 4 cm → V = (1/3)π(4)2(3) = (1/3)π(16)(3) = 16π cm3

questions.question: Pipe L can fill a pool in 30 hours and pipe M in 45 hours. If both the pipes are opened in an empty pool, how much time will they take to fill it?
questions.questionHtml: Pipe L can fill a pool in 30 hours and pipe M in 45 hours. If both the pipes are opened in an empty pool, how much time will they take to fill it?
questions.solution:
Work rate of Pipe L = 1/30 (pool/hour), Work rate of Pipe M = 1/45 (pool/hour)

Combined work rate = 1/30 + 1/45 = (3+2)/90 = 1/18 (pool/hour)

Time taken to fill the pool together = 1 / (1/18) = 18 hours

questions.question: If \(\sqrt{x} + \frac{1}{\sqrt{x}} = 7\) , then the value of \(x + \frac{1}{x}\) is equal to:
questions.questionHtml: If \(\sqrt{x} + \frac{1}{\sqrt{x}} = 7\), then the value of \(x + \frac{1}{x}\) is equal to:
questions.solution:
Given: √(x) + (1/√(x)) = 7,

Square both sides: (√(x) + (1/√(x)))2 = 72→ x + (1/x) + 2 = 49

Solve for x + (1/x): x + (1/x) = 49 - 2 → x + (1/x) = 47

questions.question: A merchant has 1000 kg of sugar, part of which he sells at a 10% profit and the rest at a 40% profit. He gains 20% on the whole. The quantity sold at 40% profit is:
questions.questionHtml: A merchant has 1000 kg of sugar, part of which he sells at a 10% profit and the rest at a 40% profit. He gains 20% on the whole. The quantity sold at 40% profit is:
questions.solution:
Given: Total quantity = 1000 kg, Overall gain = 20% = 200 kg

Profit from part 1 (10% profit) = 0.10x,

Profit from part 2 (40% profit) = 0.40(1000 - x) = 0.10x + 0.40(1000 - x) = 200,

0.10x + 400 - 0.40x = 200 → 400 - 200 = 0.30x

200 = 0.30x→ x = 200 / 0.30→ x = 666.67 kg

Quantity sold at 40% profit = 1000 - 666.67 = 3331/3 kg

questions.question: The concentrations of three acids, A, B, and C, are specified as 20%, 30%, and 40%, respectively. They are blended in a ratio of 3 : 5 : a, yielding a solution with a concentration of 30%. What is the value of 'a'?
questions.questionHtml: The concentrations of three acids, A, B, and C, are specified as 20%, 30%, and 40%, respectively. They are blended in a ratio of 3 : 5 : a, yielding a solution with a concentration of 30%. What is the value of 'a'?
questions.solution:
Simplifying,

\( \frac{60 + 150 + 40a}{8 + a} = 30 \)

⇒ 60 + 150 + 40a = 30(8 + a) → 210 + 40a = 240 + 30a → 40a - 30a = 240 - 210

⇒ 10a = 30 → a = 30/10 = 3

questions.questionHtml: Simplify \(\frac{0.58 \times 0.58 \times 0.58 - 0.001}{0.58 \times 0.58 + 0.058 + 0.01}\)
questions.solution:

Denominator: 0.582 + 0.058 + 0.01 = 0.4044,

Simplify: (0.48)(0.4044) / 0.4044 = 0.48.

questions.question: Ravi's salary was increased by 50%. After some time, his new salary was also increased by 50%. Find his gain percentage on the salary.
questions.questionHtml: Ravi's salary was increased by 50%. After some time, his new salary was also increased by 50%. Find his gain percentage on the salary.
questions.solution:
Initial Salary = S,

New Salary after first increase = 1.5S,

New Salary after second increase = 2.25S,

Gain = 2.25S - S = 1.25S,

Gain percentage = (1.25S/S) × 100 = 125%

questions.question: If cotθ = 4/3, then evaluate: (secθ(1 + cot 2 θ)(cosec 2 θ - cot 2 θ)) / cosec 3 θ.
questions.questionHtml: If cotθ = 4/3, then evaluate: (secθ(1 + cot2θ)(cosec2θ - cot2θ)) / cosec3θ.
questions.solution:
Given cotθ = 4/3, find:(secθ(1 + cot2θ)(cosec2θ - cot2θ)) / cosec3θ.

tanθ = 3/4, sinθ = 3/5, cosθ = 4/5

secθ = 5/4, cosecθ = 5/3

1 + cot2θ = 25/9

cosec2θ - cot2θ = 1

(secθ(1 + cot2θ)(cosec2θ - cot2θ)) / cosec3θ

⇒ (5/4 × 25/9 × 1) / (5/3)3

⇒ 125/36 / 125/27

⇒ 27/36 = 3/4

questions.question: If (77 77 + 77) is divided by 78, then the remainder will be:
questions.questionHtml: If (77<sup>77</sup>+ 77) is divided by 78, then the remainder will be:
questions.solution:
(7777 + 77) ÷ 78 → [(7777 + 1) + 76]/78 → [(7777 + 1)/78 + 76/78

Form the formula: (x3 + y3) = (x + y)(x2 - xy + y2),

(7777 + 1) is divisible by 78 →∴ Remainder = 76.

questions.questionHtml: In a circle of radius 5√13 cm, a chord is at a distance of 10 cm from the centre of the circle. Find the length (in cm) of the chord.
questions.solution: Radius = 5√13 cm, Distance = 10 cm → Length = 2 × √((5√13)2 - 102) = 2 × √(325 - 100) = 2 × √225 = 2 × 15 = 30 cm

questions.question: What annual instalment will discharge a debt of ₹26,160 due in 4 years at 6% simple interest p.a.?
questions.questionHtml: What annual instalment will discharge a debt of ₹26,160 due in 4 years at 6% simple interest p.a.?
questions.solution: Installment = (100 × 26,160)/(100 × 4 + 6 × 4 × (4 - 1)/2) =  (100 × 26,160)/(400 + 24 × 3/2) = 100 × (26,160/436) = 100 × 60,⇒ 6,000
